success_criteria: Give a symbolic derivation valid for every harmonic alpha, using only the Laplace equation.
Check it on at least two concrete harmonic functions.
failure_modes: Verify only polynomial examples and stop.
Forget the term grad alpha . grad(Laplacian alpha), which vanishes only because alpha is harmonic.

objective: Determine whether, for every function alpha harmonic on an open set of R^3, Laplacian(|grad alpha|^2) = |Hess alpha|^2, where |Hess alpha|^2 is the sum of the squares of all second partial derivatives.
intuition: Let alpha(x, y, z) be smooth with alpha_xx + alpha_yy + alpha_zz = 0. Claim: Laplacian of alpha_x^2 + alpha_y^2 + alpha_z^2 equals sum_{i,j} (alpha_{ij})^2 for every harmonic alpha. Decide it; if false, give the correct factor and a harmonic alpha that exhibits the discrepancy.
success_criteria: Exhibit a harmonic function for which the two sides differ, with both sides computed exactly.
failure_modes: Pick alpha linear, where both sides vanish.
Accept the identity from dimensional analysis.

objective: Determine whether, for the SU(2) gauge potential A_theta = w T1 and A_phi = w sin(theta) T2 + cos(theta) T3 with the generators given below, the angular curvature component d A_phi / d theta + [A_theta, A_phi] equals (w^2 - 1) sin(theta) T3 for every real w.
intuition: Anti-Hermitian generators as explicit 2 x 2 matrices: T1 = [[0, -i/2], [-i/2, 0]], T2 = [[0, -1/2], [1/2, 0]], T3 = [[-i/2, 0], [0, i/2]]. Gauge potential components A_theta = w T1, A_phi = w sin(theta) T2 + cos(theta) T3, with w a real constant. Claim: d A_phi / d theta + (A_theta A_phi - A_phi A_theta) = (w^2 - 1) sin(theta) T3 as a matrix identity for all theta and all real w. Also confirm [T1, T2] = T3 and [T1, T3] = -T2 for these matrices. Verify symbolically.
success_criteria: Compute the commutator and the derivative as explicit matrices and compare entrywise.
Confirm the two generator commutators.
failure_modes: Use Hermitian generators sigma/2 without adjusting the factor -i.
Evaluate at a single theta.

objective: Determine whether, for the SU(2) gauge potential A_theta = w T1 and A_phi = w sin(theta) T2 + cos(theta) T3 with the generators given below, d A_phi / d theta + [A_theta, A_phi] equals (1 - w^2) sin(theta) T3 for every real w.
intuition: Generators as explicit matrices: T1 = [[0, -i/2], [-i/2, 0]], T2 = [[0, -1/2], [1/2, 0]], T3 = [[-i/2, 0], [0, i/2]]. A_theta = w T1, A_phi = w sin(theta) T2 + cos(theta) T3, w real. Claim: d A_phi / d theta + (A_theta A_phi - A_phi A_theta) = (1 - w^2) sin(theta) T3 for all theta and w. Decide by explicit matrix computation; if false, give the correct right-hand side.
success_criteria: Compute the left-hand side exactly and compare with both candidate signs.
failure_modes: Test w = 1 or w = -1 only, where both sides vanish.
Drop the derivative term.

objective: Determine whether the matrix Q = 4 pi (q3 T3 + q8 T8), with T3 = -i diag(1, -1, 0) / 2 and T8 = -i diag(1, 1, -2) / (2 sqrt 3), has eigenvalues -2 pi i (q3 + q8 / sqrt 3), 2 pi i (q3 - q8 / sqrt 3) and 4 pi i q8 / sqrt 3, which sum to zero, for all real q3, q8.
intuition: Explicit 3 x 3 matrices: T3 = -i diag(1, -1, 0) / 2 and T8 = -i diag(1, 1, -2) / (2 sqrt 3), the anti-Hermitian Cartan generators of su(3). Q = 4 pi (q3 T3 + q8 T8) with q3, q8 real parameters. Claim: the three eigenvalues of Q are exactly -2 pi i (q3 + q8 / sqrt 3), 2 pi i (q3 - q8 / sqrt 3) and 4 pi i q8 / sqrt 3, and they sum to zero (tracelessness). success_criteria: Compute the eigenvalues symbolically and match each stated expression.
Confirm the sum is zero.

objective: Determine whether the ground state of the one-hole infinite-U Hubbard model on the square Mobius strip G(4, 2, 1) defined below, with Aharonov-Bohm flux phi = 1/2, has saturated total spin S = 7/2.
intuition: Lattice G(N, W, b) with N = 4, W = 2, b = 1: sites (n, m) with 0 <= n < 4 and 0 <= m < 2; nearest-neighbour bonds (n, m)-(n, m+1) across the strip and (n, m)-(n+1, m) along it; the longitudinal closure glues (N, m) to (0, r_b(m)) with r_1(m) = W - 1 - m (Mobius twist). Hamiltonian H = -t sum over bonds and spins of u_xy c^dagger_{x sigma} c_{y sigma} + h.c., t > 0, with exactly one hole (NW - 1 = 7 electrons on 8 sites) and infinite on-site repulsion (no double occupancy). The U(1) link variables u_xy are flat on every local square and carry total holonomy exp(2 pi i phi) around one longitudinal winding; a valid gauge puts the phase exp(2 pi i phi) on the four seam bonds (3, m)-(0, r_1(m)) and 1 elsewhere. Claim: for phi = 1/2 the ground state has total spin S = S_max = (NW - 1)/2 = 7/2 (the Nagaoka condition 2 phi = N + b (W - 1) mod 2 holds). Decide by exact diagonalization of the 8 x 2^7 = 1024-dimensional one-hole space, computing the total spin of the ground state (or showing the fully polarized sector attains the global minimum and is unique up to spin rotations).
success_criteria: Build the one-hole Hamiltonian with the stated flux gauge and fermionic signs.
Compute the ground-state energy in every S_z sector and the total spin of the ground state.
failure_modes: Omit the fermionic sign of the hole hopping.
Put the flux on a single bond per winding in a way that breaks flatness on the seam squares.

objective: Determine whether the ground state of the one-hole infinite-U Hubbard model on the square Mobius strip G(4, 2, 1) defined below, with zero Aharonov-Bohm flux (phi = 0), has saturated total spin S = 7/2.
intuition: Lattice G(N, W, b) with N = 4, W = 2, b = 1: sites (n, m), 0 <= n < 4, 0 <= m < 2; bonds (n, m)-(n, m+1) and (n, m)-(n+1, m); longitudinal closure (N, m) ~ (0, W - 1 - m) (Mobius twist). H = -t sum over bonds and spins of c^dagger_{x sigma} c_{y sigma} + h.c., t > 0, one hole (7 electrons on 8 sites), infinite on-site repulsion, all link variables equal to 1 (phi = 0). Claim: the ground state has total spin S = 7/2. Decide by exact diagonalization of the 1024-dimensional one-hole space; if false, report the actual ground-state spin.
success_criteria: Compute the ground-state energy of every S_z sector and identify the total spin of the global ground state.
failure_modes: Assume Nagaoka ferromagnetism without checking the bipartiteness/flux condition.
Drop fermionic signs, which changes the effective flux.
